node.statement: Let M be an arbitrary compact smooth manifold without boundary. By node 1.6 choose a simplicial complex K and a homeomorphism h: |K| -> M. Node 1.7 makes |K| compact; node 1.8 makes the vertex set of K finite; node 1.9 then makes K a finite simplicial complex. Thus h exhibits M as homeomorphic to a finite simplicial complex. Since M was arbitrary, this proves node 1.
